title: IdentityConsentChangedV1
description: A consent record was appended: a person granted or withdrew consent for one purpose, so processing that depends on it starts or halts (doc 11 §7.1, NFR-PRV-020). Producer `identity`; aggregate `user` with the person's `usr_` id, so `sequence` orders one person's consent changes; `subjectUserId` is that id. The purpose travels as `purpose` (doc 11 §7.1); the envelope's `consentScope` is a different field. Ids, enums and timestamps only (doc 06 §6). The full event is the envelope (envelope.json) narrowed by this schema; the payload is open content, so consumers ignore properties they do not know (doc 06 §4).

userId.description: The person whose consent changed, a prefixed ULID (`usr_`, shared-kernel `ID_PREFIXES.user`); the API's `UserId`

consentRecordId.description: The appended consent record, a prefixed ULID (`cns_`, shared-kernel `ID_PREFIXES.consentRecord`); the API's `ConsentRecord.id`

purpose.description: The consent purpose (doc 11 §7.2); mirrors shared-kernel `CONSENT_PURPOSES` and the API's `ConsentPurpose`

status.description: The purpose's state from this record on; the API's `ConsentStatus`

policyVersion.description: Version of the policy text the person saw, e.g. `0.1.0-draft`; the API's `PolicyVersion`. The consent audit entry records it (doc 14 §10)

changedAt.description: When the record was appended: its `grantedAt` when `status` is `granted`, its `withdrawnAt` when `status` is `withdrawn`
